claim: The Luxembourg-province Points-Noeuds bike network covers ~2,500 km, 530 numbered nodes across all 44 communes with about 12,000 signage panels; 85% paved and 15% unpaved, designed for VTC rather than road bikes.
quote: 85% of roads are paved (asphalt, concrete...) and 15%

claim: Two signed Points-Noeuds loops from the Bouillon tourism office explicitly pass through Our village: 'Nature et Paysages 3' (29 km, intermediate, 480 m D+) and 'Villages d'Ardenne 2' (23 km, easy, 310 m D+), with nodes PN 59 located near Our and PN 61 by Ferme des Sureaux.
quote: Nature et Paysages - 3 ... 29 km ... 480 m ... Passes through Our village

claim: Three featured Points-Noeuds loops in the Bouillon region: 'Virée Pittoresque' (19 km, 392 m D+, medium) from Bouillon, 'Immersion au Coeur des Forêts' (26 km, 540 m D+) from Bertrix, and 'Entre Vallées et Plateaux' (55 km, 943 m D+, hard) from Vresse-sur-Semois passing Laforêt.
quote: Virée Pittoresque Autour de Bouillon ... 19km ... 392m ... Medium

claim: RAVeL ligne 163 runs 57 km Gouvy–Bastogne–Libramont; the Gouvy-Bastogne leg (27.5 km) is finished asphalt RAVeL, while the Bastogne–Libramont leg (29.5 km) is still a 'pre-RAVeL' rideable on a mountain bike, sitting above 500 m on the Meuse/Rhine watershed ridge.
quote: Stage 2 (Bastogne to Libramont): 29.5 km - Currently a 'pre-RAVeL' (under development)

claim: Regional cycling route W7 (Sur la Route des Ardennes) is fully signed through Sainte-Ode, Libramont, Libin, Bertrix, Paliseul and Bouillon — giving Our a direct waymarked link from Paliseul down to Bouillon — and W5 is signed Bouillon–Corbion, eventually to Vresse and Gedinne.
quote: the towns crossed (Sainte-Ode, Libramont, Libin, Bertrix, Paliseul and Bouillon) ... signpost and mark the sections of the last two stages of the W7 regional cycling route

claim: The Bike Trail Center de Bouillon offers a 42 km enduro circuit with ~1,200 m elevation gain plus five short specific MTB loops graded blue/red/black like ski slopes, passing Cordemois, Moulin de l'Épine, Poupehan, Frahan, Rochehaut, Botassart and Sensenruth; two beginner lines exist for children aged 5–10.
quote: 42 km enduro course with approximately 1,200 m of elevation gain ... Five shorter trail circuits ... ski-slope color system

claim: Bouillon's trail center was Belgium's first officially-sanctioned trail building project, backed by local authorities and the forestry department; trails use natural terrain with sub-50 cm width and berms/jumps from fallen branches.
quote: marking Belgium's first officially-sanctioned trail building weekend

claim: The Pays de Bouillon publishes signed gravel circuits including Gravel Bouillon-Bertrix (53 km), Gravel Bertrix-Paliseul (35 km, starting from Paliseul), Gravel Bièvre (37 km), Gravel Vresse-sur-Semois (39 km) plus Herbeumont (31–38 km) and Gribomont (31 km) loops.
quote: Gravel Bertrix Paliseul ... Distance: 35 km ... Starting point: Paliseul

claim: Komoot lists 80+ MTB trails around Vresse-sur-Semois including a hard 47.4 km Saint-Lambert loop with 930 m D+ from Vresse, a moderate 31.8 km Bohan loop with 450 m D+, and an easy 8.6 km Mouzaive loop with 180 m D+ — covering all difficulty levels.
quote: Along the Semois - Saint-Lambert Bridge loop from Vresse-sur-Semois ... 47.4 km ... Hard ... 930m

claim: Cap Semois in Vresse-sur-Semois (Rue du Perré 79-80) rents Trek 500W Bosch e-MTBs at €50 half-day / €80 full day and regular VTTs at €28/€30, with 40 km turbo / 100+ km eco range, no deposit, helmet free, and itineraries of 14/20/35 km on 1,000+ km of marked trails.
quote: Half-day (4.5 hours): €28 (standard VTT), €50 (e-bike) ... Full day: €30 (standard VTT), €80 (e-bike)

claim: Récréalle in Alle-sur-Semois rents e-bikes at €25 (2-4 h) / €35 (1 day) / €60 (2 days) and regular VTTs at €25 half-day / €30 full day / €35 for 24 h, with access to several fully-marked MTB trails directly from the leisure base.
quote: E-bikes ... 2-4 hours: €25.00 ... 1 day (8 hours): €35.00 ... Mountain Bikes (VTT) ... Half-day: €25.00 ... Full day: €30.00

claim: The Maison du Tourisme de Bouillon coordinates a dense network of rental shops covering the Our/Paliseul area — Récréalle and L'Ami Pierre in Alle, Cap Semois in Vresse, Arde-Bike in Rienne, Cellier du Baudet in Bertrix, Sports in Lux in Herbeumont and AmuSemois/E-trott in Bouillon — for VTT, e-VTT and standard bikes.
quote: Location VTT Récréalle (Alle) ... Location VTT L'Ami Pierre (Alle) ... E-bike location Sensenruth ... Cap Semois - location VTT (Vresse-sur-Semois) ... Arde-Bike (Rienne)

claim: The 2021 Paliseul walking map (€7.50 from Syndicat d'Initiatives) contains 32 signed hiking circuits plus 9 marked VTT circuits covering the commune that contains Our.
quote: La nouvelle carte des promenades de Paliseul, édition 2021, contient 32 circuits pédestres balisés et 9 circuits VTT balisés
